semiconductor_relevance: High — PMT specializes in particle measurement and contamination control, which are critical for maintaining cleanroom environments in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: PMT Partikel-Messtechnik AG provides advanced particle measurement solutions and contamination control services, focusing on the analysis of ultra-pure media and monitoring of cleanrooms and sterile environments. With over 25 years of experience, the company supports the integration of high-precision measurement techniques into systems and offers tailored solutions for various applications in particle measurement.
capabilities: Custom system solutions for particle measurement

regional_presence.Europe: PMT operates in 8 countries across Europe, providing localized support and services.
